canon.title: Queen checkmate
canon.explanation: Use the queen to shrink the king's box a knight's move away, bring your own king up, then mate on the edge. Watch out for stalemate!

canon.title: Rook checkmate
canon.explanation: Cut the king off with the rook, walk your king into opposition, then check along the edge. Tempo rook moves keep the opposition.

canon.title: King in front of the pawn
canon.explanation: With your king on the 6th rank in front of the pawn you win no matter who moves — step aside with the king (Kd6/Kf6), never push the pawn too early.

canon.title: Hold the king-and-pawn ending
canon.explanation: Stay in front of the pawn and take the opposition when the enemy king approaches. Retreat straight back, never to the side.

canon.title: Lucena position
canon.explanation: Cut the black king off, then 'build a bridge': rook to the 4th rank so it can block checks on your king.

canon.title: Philidor defence
canon.explanation: Keep your rook on the 6th rank until the pawn advances, then drop the rook to the back and check from behind.

canon.title: Queen vs pawn on the 7th
canon.explanation: Check and pin until the enemy king is forced in front of its own pawn, then gain a tempo to bring your king closer.

canon.title: Rook vs bishop — hold
canon.explanation: Run your king to the corner of the colour your bishop does NOT control, and keep the bishop close.

canon.title: The wrong bishop
canon.explanation: The bishop cannot control h8 — shuttle between g8 and h8 and the rook pawn can never promote.

canon.title: Bishop and knight mate
canon.explanation: Drive the king to a corner of your bishop's colour (W-manoeuvre with the knight). You have 50 moves — plan carefully.
